title: The Winter Orchard
author: A. M. Nystrom
blurb: Beatrix Nystrom, a code-carrying courier on the last diplomatic mission of a doomed republic, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy before the century turns.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
